verdict.rationale: First-party docs show workspace administrators can control access to ChatGPT Work, plugins, browser use, and network access, and can govern GPT builders' use of approved workspace apps and permitted third-party APIs. A data-controls mention covers Computer Use screenshots, but the evidence never documents member management. Missing for 10: member invite/removal and role management, a documented admin data-retention or data-policy console, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
